title: Qantas Rewards Cards - How Is PayPal Counted for Points Accrual?
body:
Hello all,
I'm looking to get a new Qantas rewards card. I'm leaning away from Amex as its not well accepted and carries higher surcharges (but surcharges become illegal in AU from October, so i wonder how that will affect Amex), so looking at all the Visa/Mastercard options (CBA, NAB, Westpac, Qantas's own card, etc etc).
For people that frequently use these cards, i wanted to ask 2 questions that have to do with Paypal, which i use quite a bit (20% of all my CC purchases go through paypal, partially for convenience, and partially to prevent giving my real CC to a merchant)
If you put your Amex via Paypal, does that remove some of the "we dont accept amex" issues? (where paypal is accepted)
Rewards programs often categorise their reward point tiers into several buckets, such as "qantas spend", "overseas spend", "bit merchant spend such as supermarkets, petrol and utilities", and often there's a lowest tier such as "other". My question is whether payments via an intermediary such as Paypal would often automatically land in "other", even if the purchase was actually for utilities, for example. I know Westpac specifically calls this out, but not sure about other providers. Whats been your experience here?
While you're at it you can throw me your qantas credit card recommendations, or maybe tell me that its not worth it and i should go for some other type of rewards card. Our monthly spend is quite high, but our OS travel is limited to once in a couple of years. I tend to pay the balance of the card each month.
